title: Vibe Coding SimCity II: Injecting Chaos with Natural Disasters and AI Tools
description:
In this chaotic sequel, Simon Maple and Joe Holdcroft return to the AI Native Dev podcast to swap their town simulation apps, created with BASE44 and Bolt.new, using AI coding tools Cursor and Windsurf to implement natural disasters on the fly. From surprise earthquakes to lightning strikes, this episode dives into debugging chaos, tool quirks, and developer grit. Watch as the devs face bugs, logic loops, and disappearing towns—all in pursuit of building resilient, AI-assisted applications.

What You'll Learn:
- How Cursor and Windsurf handle mid-project feature additions
- The strengths and pitfalls of disposable code
- Live debugging of AI-generated applications
- Where BASE44 helps—and where it breaks
- Real-world insights on LLM integration into dev workflows

Who This Episode Is For:
Developers experimenting with AI-powered dev tools, prototypers pushing tool limits, and anyone curious about how AI helps—or hinders—modern coding workflows.

What’s the weirdest bug an AI tool ever introduced into your code? Drop your disaster stories below!
